criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.description: Assesses fit to the required clinical, data, and workflow needs.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Supported workflows, system capacity, interoperability, interfaces, test evidence, implementation dependencies, and limitations.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.description: Assesses whether delivery and validation are planned, owned, and testable.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Named clinical and technical owners, timeline, data reconciliation, validation scripts, user testing, go-live, and hypercare.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.description: Assesses price transparency and total cost over the stated contract term.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Contract term total, included BAA/interfaces/validation/support, exclusions, optional fees, and assumptions. Do not reward low price alone.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.description: Assesses documented privacy safeguards without inferring regulatory compliance.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Encryption, role-based access, incident notice, audit evidence, report scope/date, and explicit gaps. A general security claim is not proof of HIPAA or GxP compliance.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.description: Assesses clinical support coverage and relevant delivery experience.
criteria.what_to_inspect: 24/7 coverage, priority response target, downtime process, recovery objectives, comparable deployments, and support limitations.

criteria.name: HIPAA & GxP Controls
criteria.description: Evidence of applicable safeguards and validated processes.
criteria.what_to_inspect: HIPAA safeguards, BAA, GxP validation and quality processes.

criteria.name: Clinical Validation
criteria.description: Evidence supporting clinical safety and performance.

criteria.name: HL7/FHIR Interoperability
criteria.description: Exchange of health data using relevant standards.

criteria.name: Patient Data Governance
criteria.description: Patient data access, retention, consent, and deletion.

criteria.name: Safety & Quality Management
criteria.description: Quality system and safety escalation processes.
criteria.what_to_inspect: QMS, CAPA, safety reporting, audit trails.
